$Comment: Flying hold behavior for autonomous aerial companions using Tamework's managed landing controller.

HoldGroundAnimation.Description: Animation to apply once the companion is grounded in hold mode.

HoldLandingSearchRange.Description: Search-ray range used to find a landing spot while entering grounded hold.

HoldLandingSearchAngle.Description: Search-ray angle used to find a landing spot while entering grounded hold.

HoldLandingSlowDownDistance.Description: Distance from landing point where descent begins to slow.

HoldLandingStopDistance.Description: Distance from landing point considered grounded enough for hold.

HoldLandingGoalLenience.Description: Goal lenience used during landing descent.

Content.$Comment: Release combat targets, land if airborne, then stay grounded with the landed idle posture.

Instructions.$Comment: Keep combat target released while in hold mode.
While airborne, let Tamework's targeted landing controller fly toward the configured landing spot.
Apply the landed idle pose once the companion reaches the ground.
Once grounded, remain stationary in the landed posture.
